description.value: Fat Tony's Pizza has been a Whistler village staple since 2007, celebrated for its signature sesame seed crust and the Beef & Blue Cheese house special. Positioned in the heart of the village surrounded by bars and nightclubs, it caters to a wide range of diets with dedicated vegan (Daiya cheese), vegetarian, and gluten-free pizza options. Pizza by the slice is available for a quick grab-and-go stop, and delivery covers all of Whistler.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content for fattonyspizza.com fetched successfully and is rich. Phone (604) 905-0900 appears on the contact page; OSM has no phone field so there is nothing to corroborate. The site explicitly promotes takeout by the slice, delivery, and an extensive vegan/vegetarian/GF menu. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or device charging anywhere on the site, so those fields are null. Business has been operating since 2007 per the website and the copyright reads 2026, confirming it is active.
concerns: Phone number (604) 905-0900 sourced from website only; OSM phone field is empty — no cross-check possible.
Street address not explicitly printed on website; OSM address used as-is and could not be confirmed via website text.
Bike parking, water refill, and washroom availability not mentioned anywhere on the website; field visit required to assess WWC required criteria.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Fat Tony's is a legitimate, long-running food stop in central Whistler village with takeout-by-the-slice and strong dietary options relevant to touring cyclists, but all three required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are unconfirmed from available evidence. On-site verification is needed before inclusion.
